questions.question_text: The man who is seen leaning his head against his hand on the mantle in the dilapidated room. After the scene transitions to the lumber mill where he is talking to the woman in the office, what color is the jacket he is wearing?

options.B: Brown

questions.question_text: The man wearing a pinstripe suit and hat is standing in the street next to the carriage. After the woman in the carriage snaps the reins and drives away, what does this man do?

options.B: He takes off his hat and smiles/laughs.

questions.question_text: The woman wearing a blue dress with black trim is counting money in the store. When a man with sideburns enters the store and approaches the counter, who does she interact with?

options.A: She continues counting and ignores everyone.
options.B: She interacts with the man with sideburns (Frank Kennedy).
options.C: She talks to the blonde man from the first scene.
options.D: She speaks to the shopkeeper behind her.

questions.temporal_anchor: Scene transition to lumber mill platform
questions.question_text: The woman who sits on the sofa and cries into her hands in the first scene. When she is later seen standing on the elevated platform in the lumber mill overlooking the workers, what is the pattern of her dress?

options.B: Orange and black stripes/chevron

questions.question_text: In the scene with the large saw cutting wood, a man in a hat is directing the workers. Where is the woman in the striped dress positioned relative to this man?

options.A: She is standing right next to him on the ground floor.
options.B: She is standing above him on a staircase/platform.
options.C: She is sitting on a pile of lumber behind him.
options.D: She is outside the building looking through a window.

questions.question_text: The woman wearing a black hat with a yellow ribbon is driving a carriage alone through the woods. When a man jumps out and grabs the horse, what does she do?

options.B: She screams and strikes him with her whip.

questions.question_text: Ideally, the blonde man is standing in the small office. When he picks up a document/book from the desk while talking to the woman, what is the state of the object?

options.A: He holds it open in his hands.
options.B: He throws it on the floor.
options.C: He tears pages out of it.
options.D: He places it in his pocket.

questions.question_text: The woman in the blue dress is directing the installation of a sign. Where is she standing during this activity?

options.A: On the roof of the building.
options.B: On the back of a wagon/cart.
options.C: In the middle of the street on the ground.
options.D: On the balcony of the building.

questions.question_text: The woman who gives orders to the foreman in the lumber mill. Later, when she is driving the carriage and stops to talk to the man in the pinstripe suit, what color is her outfit?

options.B: Blue with black trim

questions.question_text: A group of men in striped uniforms are working in the mill. What are they primarily doing with the large logs?

options.B: Pushing them toward a large saw blade.

questions.question_text: A large man jumps from the woods to pull the attacker off the carriage. Immediately after neutralizing the attacker, who does he speak to?

options.B: He speaks to the woman in the carriage.
options.C: He talks to the man in the pinstripe suit.

questions.question_text: The woman in the blue dress is standing behind a counter. What is she holding in her hands before the man approaches her?

options.B: A stack of paper money.

questions.question_text: The woman who enters the room and comforts the crying woman on the sofa. Where does she position herself during this interaction?

options.B: She sits on the sofa next to the crying woman.

questions.question_text: The blonde man in the brown coat is in the office. What does he do when the woman suggests using 'free darkies' instead of convicts?

options.A: He slams his fist on the table.
options.B: He expresses verbal disagreement and turns away/moves.
options.D: He sits down and starts writing.

questions.question_text: The man wearing a hat who acts as the foreman in the mill. Who is he looking at when he receives instructions about the lumber delivery?

options.A: He is looking at the blonde man.
options.B: He is looking up at the woman standing on the stairs.
options.C: He is looking at the convicts.
options.D: He is looking at his watch.

questions.question_text: In the scene where the woman in the carriage is talking to a man standing in the street, what is the man wearing on his head?

options.B: A fedora/brimmed hat.

questions.question_text: During the scene where the 'Wilkes & Kennedy' sign is visible, what are the men on the ladders doing?

options.B: They are installing/adjusting the sign.
options.D: They are repairing the roof tiles.

questions.question_text: The blonde man who argues with the woman in the office walks out the door. Who follows him to the door and watches him leave?

options.B: The foreman.
options.C: The woman in the striped dress.

questions.question_text: The woman driving the carriage uses a whip to defend herself. What happens to the whip during the struggle?

options.A: She drops it on the ground.
options.B: The attacker grabs it from her hand.
options.D: She puts it back in the holder.

questions.question_text: The man who says 'I can't fight you both' at the end of the first scene. Where does he go immediately after saying this?

options.A: He sits down at the table.
options.B: He walks out of the room into the hallway.
